title: K1 chunk, version 0
description: One chunk row of the K1 chunk package, version 0: the fields Track B reads today (graphrag/data.py). Version 0 is today's corpus output; version 1 adds the spec 5.11 IDs, file and page records and report dates. Extra fields are allowed.

chunk_id.description: Today's chunk ID: <doc_id>#c<4 digits>. Gold facts and K4 citations name these IDs.

doc_id.description: The document the chunk comes from.

page.description: First PDF page of the chunk, counted from 1.

pages.description: Every PDF page the chunk covers. Only daily-report chunks carry it today.

type.description: A text passage or a table part.

section.description: Heading the chunk sits under, or null when there is none.

table_id.description: Table the chunk belongs to: <doc_id>#t<3 digits>. Null for text chunks.

row_start.description: First table row in the chunk. Null for text chunks.

row_end.description: Last table row in the chunk. Null for text chunks.
